svg.title: Alexandre Kohler, Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, backend, APIs and microservices, open source contributor to Google, Microsoft, Meta, Apple and Amazon
svg.desc: Alexandre Kohler (kwy404), Senior Full Stack Software Engineer in Brusque, SC, Brazil (UTC-3), with more than 10 years of full stack experience in backend systems, APIs and microservices using TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, Python, Go, Rust, PHP, Java, React and AWS. 161 merged pull requests in 54 organizations, including Google, Microsoft, Meta, Apple, Amazon Web Services, Mozilla, NVIDIA, Netflix, Cloudflare, ByteDance, Uber, Valve, Adobe, Salesforce, Shopify and GitHub, drawn as branches that leave one main line.
